verdict.rationale: Async job polling is a fair question for a speech-to-text API, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents synchronous file transcription (upload the audio and receive a final transcript) or streaming text, plus local CLI and Python usage. Nothing documents creating a job, job IDs, status endpoints, or job states to poll.

support.subject: As a developer, I create a transcription job and poll its status through documented job states until the result is ready
